prompt: Parents should take courses in parenting in order to improve the lives of their children. To what extent do you agree?
essay:
It is often argued that parents should take courses in parenting to improve the lives of their children. However, I personally agree with this view because such programmes can help mothers and fathers understand how to raise youngsters properly and provide them with useful guidance.

The primary reason why I agree with this view is that parenting courses can teach adults how to handle their children. This is mainly because they can learn about young people’s behaviour and emotional needs. In other words, they can understand what to do when their sons and daughters behave badly or face problems. For example, if a child becomes stubborn, parents can learn how to respond to the situation calmly instead of becoming angry. As a result, youngsters may develop better behaviour and have a healthier relationship with their family members. Therefore, parenting education can help adults raise the younger generation in a more effective way.

Furthermore, another important reason why I agree with this view is that these programmes can help mothers and fathers provide better support at home. This is because many adults are busy with their jobs and other responsibilities. For instance, a parenting course can teach them simple ways to spend quality time with their sons and daughters and communicate with them regularly. Consequently, young people can receive more attention and guidance from their caregivers. Therefore, I strongly agree with this view.

In conclusion, I firmly agree with the view that parents should take courses in parenting to enhance their children’s lives. This is mainly because such education can help adults handle youngsters properly and provide them with more effective guidance.
